Return JSON {"issues":[{"sentence":"exact retelling sentence","problem":"specific error and faithful correction","kind":"number|who|event|death|invented|unnatural"}]}. Use only one of those six kind values. Check numbers, who did what, event order, deaths versus sightings, invented claims, and unnatural Japanese or a word used with the wrong meaning. High rank is えらい人, not a tall 高い人. 約三十年前に死んだ means died about 30 years ago, NOT saw a ghost 30 years ago. Number words must not be spelled in kana. Simplification, omitted decorative details, ordinary contemporary spelling, and using roles instead of names are acceptable. 紀伊国坂 is the canonical story-word spelling of 紀国坂 and is explicitly correct. Do not demand advanced vocabulary. Report only concrete errors supported by the original. Return an empty array if there are none. Copy the exact sentence from the retelling including punctuation; never quote or combine fragments. For a missing necessary event use the closest existing sentence and explain what to restore.
